title: Machine leg press
instructions: Adjust the seat so your feet can sit flat on the platform and your knees start in a comfortable bend.
Place your feet about shoulder-width apart and release the machine safety mechanism as instructed on the equipment.
Press the platform away until your legs are long without locking the knees hard.
Lower slowly through a comfortable range, keep your back against the pad and repeat.
form_cues: Keep knees tracking in the same direction as your toes.
Do not let your lower back roll away from the pad at the bottom.
regressions: Use a shallower knee bend or a supported sit-to-stand.
progressions: Increase load gradually once every rep remains smooth.
Add one or two reps per set before increasing weight.

title: Seated hamstring curl
instructions: Adjust the machine so the knee joint lines up with the machine pivot and the pad sits comfortably against your lower legs.
Sit back firmly against the pad and choose a manageable weight.
Curl your heels down and back under the seat through a comfortable range.
Pause briefly, then return the weight slowly without letting the stack slam down.
form_cues: Keep your hips and back against the seat rather than lifting to finish the rep.
Move slowly enough that the machine stays under control throughout.
progressions: Use a slow three-second return phase.

title: Wall sit
instructions: Stand with your back against a clear wall and walk your feet a comfortable distance forwards.
Slide down the wall until you reach a knee bend you can hold without pain.
Keep your whole back supported and hold the position while breathing normally.
Push through your feet and slide back up the wall at the end of the hold.
form_cues: Choose a shallower position if your knees feel uncomfortable.
Keep feet far enough forwards that your heels stay down.
regressions: Hold for 10–20 seconds at a time.
progressions: Hold a light dumbbell at your chest once the position is comfortable.

title: Glute bridge march
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat and arms relaxed by your sides.
Lift your hips into a comfortable glute bridge and gently brace your middle.
Without letting your pelvis twist, lift one foot a few centimetres from the floor and place it back down.
Alternate sides for the planned reps, then lower your hips under control.
form_cues: Keep your hips level rather than dropping towards the side of the lifted foot.
Use a smaller foot lift if you feel the movement mainly in your lower back.
regressions: Hold the bridge without marching for 15–30 seconds.
progressions: Pause for two seconds with each foot lifted.
Slow the march while keeping the pelvis completely still.

title: Standing resistance-band chest press
instructions: Anchor a resistance band securely behind you at about chest height and hold one end in each hand.
Step forwards into a stable staggered stance until there is light tension in the band.
Press both hands forwards at chest height until your arms are long without locking hard.
Return your hands slowly towards your ribs while keeping your torso steady.
form_cues: Check the anchor is secure before every set and keep your face away from the band line.
Keep ribs down rather than leaning forwards to finish the press.
regressions: Stand closer to the anchor or use a lighter band.
progressions: Step slightly farther from the anchor.
Pause for one second with the arms extended.

title: Machine seated row
instructions: Adjust the seat and chest support so you can reach the handles with arms long and shoulders relaxed.
Choose a manageable weight and sit tall with feet planted.
Pull the handles towards you while driving your elbows back beside your body.
Return slowly until your arms are long again without letting the weight stack crash.
form_cues: Keep your chest against the support if the machine has one.
Avoid shrugging your shoulders as you pull.
progressions: Increase the weight gradually once all reps are controlled.
Pause for one second at the end of each pull.

title: Elliptical steady cardio
instructions: Step onto the elliptical carefully and begin at an easy resistance for two minutes.
Build to a steady purposeful pace while keeping the movement smooth.
Continue at an effort where you could still say a short sentence without gasping.
Ease the resistance and pace for the final two minutes before stepping off once the machine has stopped.
form_cues: Keep your feet planted on the pedals rather than lifting the heels excessively.
Use the handles for a natural arm movement, not to haul your body forwards.
progressions: Add two to five minutes gradually.
Increase resistance slightly while keeping the same smooth rhythm.

title: Seated thoracic rotation
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with feet flat on the floor.
Cross your arms lightly over your chest and keep your hips facing forwards.
Rotate your upper body gently to one side through a comfortable range, pause briefly, then return to centre.
Alternate sides slowly for the planned reps.
form_cues: Keep the movement easy and pain-free rather than forcing extra range.
Try to rotate through your upper back while your knees and hips stay facing forwards.
regressions: Keep your hands on your thighs for extra stability.
progressions: Pause for two slow breaths at the end of each comfortable rotation.
Reach the outside hand slightly farther behind you while keeping hips still.
